get.description:
Retrieve the site Zobjects.

Appart from the fields listed below, you can also filter by custom attributes.
Format: `key=value`.
Example: if you have a custom attribute `psl_id` you can filter by `psl_id=1234`

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Filter by ascending or descending order

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number to return, with per_page dictating page size

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of records to return per page

200.description: Response will contain an array of Zobjects

per_page.description: the number of results returned per page

pages.description: the total number of pages available, using per_page

parameters.name: Content-Type
parameters.description: Specify the request content type (Default: application/json)

friendly_title.description: The friendly title of the zobject

id.description: ID of the zobject picture. Needed in case of update

attachment.description: File Attachment of the zobject picture (Only supported in requests with content-type multipart/form-data)

_destroy.description: True if you want to remove the picture from the zobject
